# Thryft

> Thryft (thryft.life) is a marketplace for premium pre-owned Apple products — iPhone, iPad, MacBook, Mac Mini, iMac, Apple Watch, AirPods, Apple Pencil and Apple TV — where people buy and sell at prices well below retail.

## What Thryft offers
- Premium pre-owned products at 50-70% off original retail prices
- Every item is inspected and authenticated before listing
- Sellers can list their own devices on the Sell page
- Sustainable shopping that supports a circular economy
